- We want to interact with our agents anywhere, anytime, and on any device. And the sessions shoul"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"d be consistent.
- Agent CLI sessions should be long-lived, so we do not need to keep typing `/resum"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"e consistent.

Windows Desktop hosts sessions with ConPTY; Linux, macOS"},{"id":"p12s2","text":", and server Nodes use long-lived tmux sessions.
